rationale: Known-correct repair verified on 1 October 2026 (docs/part5-findings.md section 8): crc32c_config.h hardcodes HAVE_MM_PREFETCH 1, which pulls the x86-only xmmintrin.h into the ARM64 build.

edits.new_text:
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__) || defined(_M_X64) || defined(_M_IX86)
#define HAVE_MM_PREFETCH 1
#else
#define HAVE_MM_PREFETCH 0
#endif
